text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(The wind caresses my flushed body.
Sweat dripping from my brow stings my eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (It hurts, it's so tough. Exhausting, so hot...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Smack!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Good job, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You took first place from me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Pearl-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
I trained with all my might, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I'm still no match for you!
Running together makes me realize just how strong you really are.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah. Um! —Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Did my back still shine brightly to you?
Enough to be someone to look up to—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The answer is—right over there.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
OOOOOOOH!!
CRAAAAFT!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
More than anyone else today,
it was you who stole everyone's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Even with our full, radiant brilliance, it was you—who tried to surpass it—who ignited this frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Come on, bring it, Craft—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Next, it's our turn to chase after you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I want to see what lies further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I can't let it end yet. I can't stop now, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because now—it's my turn to form the line.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—This year, many Tiara Umamusume
are running in the "Queen Elizabeth II Cup."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...So next time, over there. Would that be alright?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!
